lines.en: You dropped this!
Um, thanks, but you--
I was gonna walk you home from school, but I couldn't find you!
Hey!
Freddie, were you just looking at your peephole waiting for me to come home?
- No! - Freddie?
Yes.
What?
Don't you think we both deserve one nice dance tonight
with a person we don't wanna kill?
Absolutely.
Hey, Teba.
Turn off the music?
What are you doing here?
I was trying to get some alone time.
Oh, you want some alone time?
Try going on a trip with you.
You're right. I'm sorry. I ditched you.
It's just, ever since I got divorced, the second time--
also the first time, but mostly the second time--
I just felt like I'm never gonna meet someone who's right for me.
You feel that way about Brooke?
I don't know. Maybe it's fun making out with her.
Maybe it's fun making out with her.
Maybe it's funny.
